content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: The post is in the Department of Psychiatry of the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi. It serves an ICMR-funded project on Geriatric Mental Health. The project develops and validates a digital intervention for elderly patients with cognitive impairment and their caregivers, through a two-arm parallel randomized controlled trial. Dr Preethy K, Assistant Professor in the Department of Psychiatry, AIIMS Delhi, is the Principal Investigator and signed the notice on 16 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Post Graduate Degree in Psychology, including the integrated PG degrees, with three years post qualification Experience or PhD in Psychology. The three years of post-qualification experience applies to the PG degree route. Candidates with a PhD in Psychology are listed as an alternative. Experience of working in Geriatric Mental Health. Experience of working with patients with dementia. Experience in clinical research and project management. At least one publication. The age limit printed in the notice is 40 Years. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is fixed "As per ICMR Guidelines – Rs. 67,100 + HRA @ 30% [= Rs 87,100/Month]". HRA at 30% is paid in addition to the Rs. 67,100. The project runs for 3 years. Tenure is six months initially, with extension up to 3 years depending on performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: All applications must be submitted online through the form linked in the notice (https://forms.gle/KW9Q2LAq3kRee3mQ8). The CV and documents are also submitted online. No hand delivered or hard copy applications will be accepted. Applications close on 31 October 2026 at 23:59 IST. CV, submitted online. Documents, submitted online with the CV. Original documents, to be brought at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only eligible candidates will be called for the interview. The notice does not mention the interview date, venue or mode. Candidates called for the interview must bring their original documents. No TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the interview. If ineligibility is detected at any stage of the recruitment, the appointment will be cancelled.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 1 (ONE) vacancy for Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) in the Department of Psychiatry, AIIMS New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for online submission of the CV and documents is 31 October 2026, 23:59 IST.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate Degree in Psychology, including the integrated PG degrees, with three years post qualification Experience, or a PhD in Psychology. Experience in geriatric mental health, dementia care, clinical research and project management, and at least one publication are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit printed in the notice is 40 Years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical)?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 67,100 + HRA @ 30% as per ICMR Guidelines. The notice prints the monthly total as Rs 87,100/Month.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. HRA @ 30% is paid in addition to Rs. 67,100.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the application, CV and documents online at https://forms.gle/KW9Q2LAq3kRee3mQ8 by 31 October 2026, 23:59 IST. No hand delivered or hard copy applications will be accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Only eligible candidates will be called for the interview, and they must bring their original documents. No TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a project post on an ICMR-funded project of 3 years' duration. Tenure is six months initially, with extension up to 3 years depending on performance.
